entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ah, [lName]-senpai—so nice to see you!
How've you been?
How's it going?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've been doing quite well.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's going wonderfully.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Are you also about to eat lunch,[n][lName]-senpai?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: If it's all right with you, would you mind[n]eating together?
entries.uk: Якщо ви не проти, може,[n]пообідаємо разом?

entries.en: Good idea.
Sure.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, how nice to see you two together.
entries.uk: О, як приємно бачити вас удвох.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, would you like to join us for lunch,[n]Dr. Maruki? We were just discussing[n]eating together.
entries.uk: О, не хочете пообідати з нами,[n]лікарю Марукі? Ми саме говорили[n]про те, щоб поїсти разом.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Are you sure? Well, maybe I will tag[n]along, then.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Umm, is that... your lunch, [n]Yoshizawa-san?
She's a growing lady.
Well, she is an athlete.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That doesn't really...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I have to eat this much to stay active![n]I always burn through everything I eat!
entries.uk: Мені треба стільки їсти, щоб мати[n]сили! Я завжди спалюю все,[n]що з'їдаю!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: From my point of view, it's your two[n]lunches that are the issue here.
entries.uk: Як на мене, проблема тут — якраз[n]ваші два обіди.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: If you're going to strengthen your body,[n]you have to eat right. You should really[n]work on your diets.
entries.uk: Хочете зміцнити тіло — треба[n]правильно харчуватися. Вам обом[n]варто подбати про свій раціон.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Hahaha, touché.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And you're right, yours does look[n]nutritious.
entries.uk: І твоя правда: твій обід справді[n]має поживний вигляд.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You know...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You seem to be giving off a different[n]vibe lately.
entries.uk: Останнім часом ти справляєш[n]якесь інакше враження.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes! I was able to put my problems in[n]the past and move on.
entries.uk: Так! Я змогла лишити свої проблеми[n]в минулому й рухатися далі.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, so that's what it is. You don't seem to[n]be overexerting yourself, either.
entries.uk: А, то ось у чому річ. І, схоже,[n]ти більше не перенапружуєшся.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm sorry I'd worried you.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, not at all. It's wonderful to hear[n]how you've been.
entries.uk: О, зовсім ні. Чудово чути,[n]що в тебе все гаразд.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I must admit, I'm a bit surprised. If you[n]don't mind my asking, was there some[n]kind of reason for this breakthrough?
entries.uk: Мушу визнати, я трохи здивований.[n]Якщо не секрет — чи був якийсь[n]привід для такого прориву?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's all thanks to [lName]-senpai and[n]his acquaintances.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I suppose you could say they gave me[n]a reason to rethink things—or, more like[n]a reason to stand up to my problems.
entries.uk: Можна сказати, вони дали мені привід[n]усе переосмислити — чи, радше,[n]стати своїм проблемам віч-на-віч.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Isn't that right, [lName]-senpai?
That's right.
You'd better be grateful.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Stand up to your problems, eh?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You've grown to be very strong,[n]Yoshizawa-san.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Mmhm, I'm totally over it now!
entries.uk: Угу, тепер це все в минулому!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry for talking so much. Why don't we[n]focus on our lunches?
entries.uk: Вибачте, що я стільки говорю.[n]Може, візьмімося вже до обіду?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thanks for the food!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, I forgot I have PE next.
entries.uk: Ой, я забула, що в мене далі[n]фізкультура.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I should get going. Please excuse me!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yoshizawa-san really does seem to have[n]found her footing.
entries.uk: Йошізава-сан, схоже, справді[n]знайшла опору під ногами.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She seemed absolutely tormented about[n]her situation just the other day...
entries.uk: А ще зовсім недавно вона, здавалося,[n]страшенно мучилася через своє[n]становище...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I have to say, this drastic change has[n]really knocked me for a loop. Perhaps[n]the Phantom Thieves changed her heart?
entries.uk: Скажу чесно, така різка зміна мене[n]приголомшила. Може, це Фантомні[n]Злодії змінили її серце?

entries.en: I don't think so.
Anything's possible.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Haha, I was just joking.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Looks like time's up. You should head[n]back to class as well.
entries.uk: Схоже, час вийшов. Тобі теж[n]пора повертатися на урок.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: See you around.
